payload.businessObjective: Develop a binary classification model that predicts the likelihood that a transaction is fraudulent before downstream financial loss occurs. The objective is to improve fraud detection performance while reducing unnecessary manual reviews, minimizing customer friction, and lowering fraud losses through more accurate risk prioritization.
payload.intendedModelUse: The model will generate a fraud risk score for each transaction. The score will be used by fraud operations to prioritize transactions for review, support automated fraud decision rules, and improve investigative efficiency. During development the model is intended solely for analytical evaluation and is not approved for production decision making.
payload.targetDefinition: Predict whether an individual transaction will ultimately be confirmed as fraudulent based on the organization's established fraud investigation and case resolution process.
payload.populationDefinition:
All eligible payment transactions included within the development datasets that satisfy the defined business inclusion criteria. The model is intended to generalize to future production transactions processed through the same fraud detection workflow.

Observation Window

Transactions occurring during the defined model development period used to construct the TRAIN, TEST, and Out-of-Time (OOT) validation datasets.

Performance Window

Fraud outcomes are evaluated after a sufficient investigation and resolution period has elapsed so that each transaction can be assigned a finalized fraud outcome for model development and validation.

Validation Plan

Separate TRAIN / TEST / OOT
